reference.evidence_scope: Complete original six-cell CSV diagnostics, not reconstructed endpoint-level graph signatures.

native_predicate_project_extension.remaining_verification: Retain BAD BIOLINK as an actual external-model finding. These exact native properties are registered project extensions, not equivalent rewrites. Validate each assertion's domain, range, source evidence, original relation and positive/negative meaning separately; registration alone is not a row-level pass.

class_subsumption_row_evidence_required.remaining_verification: Join complete assertions and both endpoints to the exact declared class/strain rule. Check original rdfs:subClassOf relation, distinct endpoints, reviewed namespace/type boundaries and source evidence. The CSV lacks those fields, so neither every ontology class nor every OrganismTaxon is automatically accepted.

growth_medium_row_evidence_required.remaining_verification: GrowthMedium is a project extension, but that does not approve this subclass assertion. Obtain exact medium/parent declarations, original relation and reviewed class semantics before granting a row disposition.

taxon_phenotype_row_evidence_required.remaining_verification: Require an OrganismTaxon bearer and a METPO/PATO/OMP phenotype-class target with the reviewed substantive categories and retained evidence. Arbitrary Attribute, chemical or NamedThing targets are not allowed. The signature-only CSV cannot establish this endpoint pair.

chemical_role_row_evidence_required.remaining_verification: Require exact CHEBI subject/object identifiers, RO:0000087 relation, a native ChemicalRole object and the reviewed macromolecule-class source category/evidence. Do not broadly classify all MacromolecularComplex nodes as chemicals.

food_taxon_row_evidence_required.remaining_verification: Require a FOODON food-material subject, RO:0002162 relation, OrganismTaxon object, and authoritative source evidence. Distinguish a food part/material from a whole organism; do not infer identities or types from this single category cell.

ontology_category_source_review_required.remaining_verification: Retain the external domain/range finding. OntologyClass, alone or in a union, does not establish the biological type needed by this predicate. Inspect full source declarations, authoritative class ancestry, relation and both endpoints; isolate confirmed source defects upstream. No blanket ontology-import waiver.

domain_range_source_review_required.remaining_verification: Retain the external domain/range finding. Obtain exact assertions, both category sets and authoritative source evidence; distinguish model inheritance/mixin limitations from source mapping or categorization defects. No rule follows from prefix, label, repeated CSV count or candidate graph membership alone.
